exemplar: Columbus claims the islands he reached for Spain are populous and valuable, and that by taking possession of them he has extended the Spanish crown's dominion across the ocean.
The Spanish monarchs funded Columbus because they sought direct access to the wealth of Asia - gold, spices, and trade routes that bypassed Portuguese and Ottoman middlemen.

Las Casas and other critics condemned the encomienda system and the violence of conquest, arguing that Spanish treatment of Native peoples violated Christian and natural law - the core of the Black Legend debate.
parts: A. Briefly describe Columbus's claim about the lands he encountered, as expressed in the excerpt.
B. Briefly explain ONE motive that led the Spanish monarchs to sponsor Columbus's voyage.
C. Briefly explain ONE criticism of Spanish colonization that emerged in the decades after Columbus's voyages.

stimulus.attribution: Christopher Columbus, letter to Luis de Santangel, February 1493 (contemporary translation).
stimulus.text: I discovered many islands inhabited by numerous people. I took possession of all of them for our most fortunate King... They are very fertile, and will be very useful.

exemplar: The photograph shows the World Trade Center's towers engulfed in smoke and fire after the hijacked airliners struck - a moment when an attack on civilians became visible to the entire nation in real time.
The attacks led directly to the USA PATRIOT Act (2001), which expanded federal surveillance powers, and to the creation of the Department of Homeland Security.

Critics argued the response went too far: civil-liberties advocates warned that warrantless surveillance and indefinite detention at Guantanamo sacrificed constitutional protections in the name of security.
parts: A. Briefly describe what the photograph shows about the September 11, 2001 attacks.
B. Briefly explain ONE way the federal government changed its domestic powers in response to the attacks.
C. Briefly explain ONE criticism of the government's response to the attacks.

stimulus.text: The photograph shows the twin towers of the World Trade Center in Lower Manhattan wreathed in thick smoke and flame, with debris and ash filling the air. Emergency vessels are visible in the harbor below. The image captures the scale of destruction inflicted on the American homeland in a single morning.
